error.no_path_to_unit: The gateway answered, but it has no path to a ventilation unit. Check the ComfoNet cable.
error.no_ventilation_unit: The gateway answered, but it does not reach a ComfoAir Q or Flex ventilation unit (connection state {state}). Check the ComfoNet cable and the unit's firmware.

data_description.baudrate: The baud rate set on the gateway's Protocols and services page.
data_description.device: The serial port wired to the gateway's RS-485 terminals A and B. Ports shared over the network by a serial proxy, such as an ESPHome device, are listed here alongside the local ones.
data_description.parity: The parity set on the gateway. The default is even. Without parity, the gateway uses 2 stop bits.

serial.description: Set up a ComfoConnect PRO wired to a serial port over RS-485. Select Modbus RTU on the gateway's Protocols and services page first.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the ComfoConnect PRO, as shown on its Network page.
data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port to connect on. The gateway uses 502.
data_description.unit_id: The Modbus unit ID set on the gateway's Protocols and services page. The default is 1.

tcp.description: Set up a ComfoConnect PRO on your network. Select Modbus TCP on the gateway's Protocols and services page first.

user.description: The ComfoConnect PRO speaks Modbus over the network or over its RS-485 terminals. Choose the one selected on the gateway's Protocols and services page.
